query: Which supply-side supports (vendor float, short-term cold-chain, aggregation) are most cost-effective to prevent voucher-driven price inflation while sustaining vendor participation?

response.query: Which supply-side supports (vendor float, short-term cold-chain, aggregation) are most cost-effective to prevent voucher-driven price inflation while sustaining vendor participation?
response.answer: Short-term cold-chain supply-side support is most cost-effective to prevent voucher-driven price inflation while sustaining vendor participation. It ensures timely delivery and maintains product quality. Vendor float and aggregation are less effective in this context.
